name: goodmem
description: Persistent memory for AI workflows: store knowledge in access-controlled spaces on your GoodMem Cloud instance and retrieve it with semantic search and reranking.

interface.shortDescription: Give your agent persistent memory: spaces, semantic retrieval, and reranking
interface.longDescription: GoodMem gives your agent persistent memory on your GoodMem Cloud instance. Sign in once with your GoodMem account — no API keys, no local server — and Codex connects to your instance through GoodMem's hosted service. Create spaces to hold memories, save what you and Codex read, and search it back with semantic retrieval. Narrow searches with metadata filters, and let an LLM summarize the retrieved memories into a direct answer. Comes with ready-made skills for common memory workflows, plus Python, TypeScript, Java, and .NET SDK references for building GoodMem into your own applications.
